comparisons.peer_topic: Stock Repurchase Program Activity and Status
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD's authorized $12 billion stock repurchase program saw the company repurchase 5.9 million shares for $862 million during the fiscal year ended December 28, 2024, with $4.7 billion remaining as of that date. The program has no termination date and may be suspended or discontinued at any time without obligation to acquire any specific amount of stock.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVDA disclose active share repurchase programs under Item 8. AMD repurchased $862 million (5.9 million shares) in FY2024 under a $12 billion authorization, leaving $4.7 billion remaining. In contrast, NVDA repurchased $9.7 billion (21 million shares) in FY2024 under a fresh $25 billion authorization (approved Aug 2023), leaving $22.5 billion remaining. Both companies state their programs have no expiration date and may be suspended or discontinued. A key difference is the scale and pace: NVDA’s repurchase volume ($9.7B) was significantly larger than AMD’s ($862M), reflecting NVDA's massive cash generation. Additionally, NVDA explicitly states the program aims to offset dilution from employee shares, while AMD’s summary does not explicitly state this purpose in the provided sentences, though both note the programs are not obligations.

sentences.text: In August 2023, our Board of Directors approved an increase to our share repurchase program of an additional $25.0 billion, without expiration.
During fiscal year 2024, we repurchased 21 million shares of our common stock for $9.7 billion.
As of January 28, 2024, we were authorized, subject to certain specifications, to repurchase additional shares of our common stock up to $22.5 billion.
Our share repurchase program aims to offset dilution from shares issued to employees.
The Company has an approved stock repurchase program authorizing repurchases of up to $12 billion of the Company's common stock (Repurchase Program).
During the year ended December 28, 2024, the Company repurchased 5.9 million shares of its common stock under the Repurchase Program for $862 million.
As of December 28, 2024, $4.7 billion remained available for future stock repurchases under this program.
This Repurchase Program does not obligate the Company to acquire any common stock, has no termination date and may be suspended or discontinued at any time.
